audit.whatIsWrong: The layers disagreed across four rows: phases[1..4].side all read 'Skill' while win[1..4] all read 'Ziggs'.
audit.why: The content layer matches packet.levelChart and the lane reality — Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 units against Breath of Light's 750, so Ziggs owns every stage before Aurelion Sol's first item at a 48.44% matchup.
audit.corrected: Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol, with phases[1] through phases[4] flipped to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named 'Starsurge', 'Voice of Light', 'Comet of the Legend' and a 'Q stun', and carried no cooldown numbers anywhere (packet reported zero sequencing cues).
audit.why: None of those exist on the current Aurelion Sol; his Q is a channelled beam with no stun. Meanwhile Ziggs' whole rhythm is numeric: Bouncing Bomb 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850, Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s at 5000.
audit.corrected: Every spike and prose field rebuilt on the real kit with those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was never stated: Satchel Charge's knockback is displacement, and displacement cancels channels.
audit.why: Breath of Light and Astral Flight are both flagged 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Satchel Charge knocks you away, so it ends the beam mid-burn and simultaneously knocks Ziggs himself out of your black hole. That one 20-to-12 second cooldown is the entire lane, in both directions.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0], early, breakdown.cooldowns, enemyWin, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[0].d.

audit.why: The brief's missingInteractions claims Satchel Charge 'bypasses stacking resistances', which derives from a percentHealth flag Riot's own description does not support — the text says only that it deals magic damage and knocks enemies away. I asserted nothing about resistances and left the itemization line alone.
audit.corrected: No edit made; recorded as unverified.

notes: Audited on the brief's games=128 per the MC_REAL_GAMES rule. whys[2] described Mega Inferno Bomb at the level-3 row, four levels before Ziggs has it — replaced with Hexplosive Minefield, which is what actually denies ground at that stage. Fabricated names killed: 'Starsurge', 'Voice of Light', 'Comet of the Legend', and a 'Q stun' the current kit does not have.
